name: Billion Industrial Holdings Limited
summary: Billion Industrial Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing and sales of polyester filament yarns, polyester, polyester industrial yarns, and ES fiber products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It provides drawn textured yarns, fully drawn yarns, and partially oriented yarns used in the production of high-end fabrics and textiles for various consumer products, including apparel, footwear, and home furnishings.
